stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

```
import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])   # this instance's own log: the folder keeps every earlier one's
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
```

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(mr[i],mc[j]),(mr[i],mc[j+1]),(mr[i+1],mc[j]),(mr[i+1],mc[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
    return out

import collections
def analyze(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals=collections.Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    fill=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]!=fill for r in range(H))]
    inter={(r,c):g[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols}
    noninter=[g[r][c] for r in hrows for c in range(W) if c not in vcols]+\
             [g[r][c] for r in range(H) if r not in hrows for c in vcols]
    lc=collections.Counter(noninter).most_common(1)[0][0] if noninter else None
    M={k:v for k,v in inter.items() if v!=lc}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    return dict(fill=fill,lc=lc,hlines=hrows,vlines=vcols,marked=sorted(M.items()),mr=mr,mc=mc)

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(mr[i],mc[j]),(mr[i],mc[j+1]),(mr[i+1],mc[j]),(mr[i+1],mc[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
    return out

def lines(g):

def analyze(g):
    b,l,hr,vc,mh,mv=lines(g)
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    hr_all=[r for r in range(H) if all(g[r][c]!=b for c in range(W))]

    M={(r,c):g[r][c] for r in hr_all for c in vc_all if g[r][c] not in (b,l)}

def rooms(g,out):
    b,l,hr,vc,M=analyze(g)
    mh=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mv=sorted({c for _,c in M})

            cv=[M[x] for x in cs if x in M]
            row.append((out[i][j], cv))
        print(i,row)

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in vals.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hrows=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for c in range(W))]
    vcols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=block for r in range(H))]
    M={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols
       if grid[r][c] not in (block,line)}
    mr=sorted({r for r,_ in M}); mc=sorted({c for _,c in M})
    nR,nC=len(mr)-1,len(mc)-1
    out=[[block]*nC for _ in range(nR)]
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            corners=[(mr[i],mc[j]),(mr[i],mc[j+1]),(mr[i+1],mc[j]),(mr[i+1],mc[j+1])]
            cv=[M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            if len(cv)==4 and len(set(cv))==1: out[i][j]=cv[0]
    return out

def full_lines(g):
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cc=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); block=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]

    hr=[r for r in range(R) if all(g[r][c]!=block for c in range(C))]
    vc=[c for c in range(C) if all(g[r][c]!=block for r in range(H:=R))]

def full_lines(g):
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cc=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); block=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in cc.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hr=[r for r in range(R) if all(g[r][c]!=block for c in range(C))]
    vc=[c for c in range(C) if all(g[r][c]!=block for r in range(R))]
    return block,line,hr,vc
for i,(gin,gout) in enumerate(pairs):
    b,l,hr,vc=full_lines(gin)
    print(f"pair{i}: in {len(gin)}x{len(gin[0])} block={b} line={l} hlines={hr} vlines={vc}")
    print("   out colors:", sorted(set(v for r in gout for v in r)), "dims", len(gout), len(gout[0]))
    mk=[(r,c,gin[r][c]) for r in hr for c in vc if gin[r][c] not in (b,l)]
    mrs=sorted({r for r,_,_ in mk}); mcs=sorted({c for _,c,_ in mk})
    print(f"   marked rows={mrs} cols={mcs} -> dims {len(mrs)-1}x{len(mcs)-1}")
    print("   unmarked hlines:", [x for x in hr if x not in mrs], "unmarked vlines:", [x for x in vc if x not in mcs])

def full_lines(g):
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cc=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); block=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[v for v,c in cc.most_common() if v!=block][0]
    hr=[r for r in range(R) if all(g[r][c]!=block for c in range(C))]
    vc=[c for c in range(C) if all(g[r][c]!=block for r in range(R))]
    return block,line,hr,vc
